title: Outlook: choose unread or total item count for each folder in the folder pane
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and its product licensing and prerequisite statements match Microsoft Learn. Targeted searches confirmed the reported gaps in folder-count administration, pricing and cross-client persistence documentation; no correction is required.

claims.claim: The change lets folders in the Outlook folder pane display unread counts or total item counts.
claims.quote: You can now pick whether each folder in your folder pane shows the unread count or the total item count.

claims.claim: Outlook on the web must be enabled for the mailboxes of users receiving new Outlook for Windows.
